subject.title: feat(mcp): open App views from channel replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept a short-lived opaque standalone-view URL as a deliberately internet-reachable bearer capability when Gateway Funnel exposure is enabled or preserved?
rationale: The branch intentionally makes the capability reachable by anyone who receives or is forwarded the URL; tests can validate expiry and construction but cannot decide whether that distribution model is acceptable for the product.

options.title: Approve bounded Funnel capability
options.body: Accept the short-lived bearer-ticket model for explicitly configured Funnel exposure, contingent on the planned real-user proof and current expiry/lease guarantees.

options.title: Limit launches to tailnet origins
options.body: Permit channel launch actions only for tailnet-only Serve origins, avoiding public bearer URLs at the cost of Funnel usability.

options.title: Require recipient-bound authorization
options.body: Redesign standalone-view launch so a forwarded URL alone cannot open the view, which increases implementation and channel compatibility complexity.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Funnel capability
recommendation.body: Accept the short-lived bearer-ticket model for explicitly configured Funnel exposure, contingent on the planned real-user proof and current expiry/lease guarantees.
